title: Dataset Catalogues & Search Engines
blurb: Large catalogues and search tools that index thousands of datasets held elsewhere. The catalogues are free to use, but some datasets they list charge fees, so check each dataset's terms.

items.name: Health Data Research Gateway
items.description: UK national catalogue of 1,400+ health datasets (NHS records, cohorts, biobanks, trials, registries) with standardised metadata, search filters and a common data-access request workflow.
items.access_note: Catalogue free to search. Access to each dataset is via its custodian: many are free, some charge fees.

items.name: BrainX AI Data Catalogue
items.description: Community-curated list of ~300 medical AI datasets, benchmarks and resources (imaging, EHR, NLP, LLM evaluation, wearables) maintained by the BrainX AI community.
items.access_note: Free web list; each linked dataset has its own terms, and a few are fee-based.

items.name: Global Health Data Exchange (GHDx)
items.description: IHME's searchable catalogue of the world's surveys, censuses, vital registration and disease registries, linking to source data wherever available.
items.provider: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation
items.access_note: Catalogue free to search; access terms of each linked dataset vary.

items.name: Google Dataset Search
items.description: Search engine indexing dataset descriptions across thousands of repositories — useful for finding datasets not listed here.
items.access_note: Free web search; results include both free and paid datasets.

items.name: Mobilize Center Datasets
items.description: Curated list of wearable-sensor and human-movement datasets (accelerometry, biomechanics, gait) such as AddBiomechanics and NHANES accelerometry.
items.access_note: Free list; each dataset has its own terms, and some (e.g. UK Biobank) are fee-based.
